assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original provisional game environment background for a browser-based community initiation adventure.
Primary request: landscape 16:9 dark fantasy pixel-art nighttime floating ruined city, with a central stone path leading toward a luminous cyan portal.
Scene/backdrop: deep blue starry night, monumental broken arches and floating ancient architecture, tiny warm golden lights in the ruins. Layered atmospheric depth from detailed dark stone foreground into misty distant sky islands.
Style/medium: richly detailed, deliberately pixelated game concept art with crisp square pixels, restrained dithering and cinematic atmosphere.
Composition/framing: wide 16:9 landscape. Clear center path and portal near the center distance. Keep upper left relatively quiet and dark for interface text. Environment only.
Lighting/mood: mysterious, contemplative, inviting discovery. Cyan portal glow against indigo and muted charcoal, sparse gold lights.
Constraints: original composition, no imitation of any exact existing image. No people, no traveler, no text, no letters, no logos, no watermark.
assets.review: Wide environment, atmospheric depth and central route/courtyard present, no visible text or logos. No variants or retries generated.
